recipe.subject: The reference image shows the stick of dynamite to draw: keep its shape, parts and colours. A single stick of red dynamite: a smooth red paper cylinder with two thin dark brown rings near each end and flat cream paper ends, a pale grey cord fuse curling out of its top end with a charred black tip, with five long black iron coffin nails with flat square heads lashed along its sides by a few turns of rough twine, the nails longer than the stick so their sharp points stick out past its ends, the fuse lit: a big bright yellow and orange spark burst fizzing at its tip with a few tiny sparks flying off, easy to see, plain paper with no letters, numbers or writing anywhere on it, lying diagonally
